name: Love Afterdeath The One Who Never Left My Side
original_name: Love Afterdeath The One Who Never Left My Side
overview: Adrián, heir to the powerful Gómez de Norteplata family, must choose a fiancée among five heirs when he turns 22, due to an agreement between his mother and her friends. In his past life, obsessed with Camila, he was betrayed when she faked her death before the wedding. She discovered that the others were accomplices and died in an accident. Only Valeria, his supposed rival, took care of his funeral. Upon being reborn, Adrián sees the truth, rejects Camila and chooses Valeria.
